text:
mia: quick design/a11y QA on the export modal — when I open the confirmation the screen reader reads 'Are you sure?' then immediately reads the whole JSON-ish details block. feels noisy. also the primary CTA says `Export` — should it be more explicit like 'Start export' or 'Export 12 vectors'? attaching a short clip. josh: I can repro. likely focus lands on the first interactive element instead of the dialog heading so SR announces the button label then the long description. we should: ensure focus moves to the dialog container/heading and wire aria-describedby for the short summary. also avoid dumping the full file preview into the accessible tree by default. An idea for markup: ```html

Export vectors

Export 12 vectors — CSV with id + vector columns. Runs in background.

``` anita: +1 to moving initial focus to the heading. For screen readers we prefer the SR to hear a concise summary first. Guidance: - initial focus on heading or set `tabindex=-1` on heading and `focus()` it in the dialog open handler - use `aria-describedby` for the short summary only (one sentence) - keep large previews collapsed by default and provide a button "Show export preview (opens below)" — don't expose full preview to SR unless expanded - include an accessible label on the confirm CTA: `aria-label=\"Confirm export of 12 vectors\"` so people using alternative UIs get the context leo: copy suggestions: - Title: "Export 12 vectors" - Summary line: "CSV: id, embedding — background export, you'll be notified when finished." - Primary CTA: `Start export` (verb-focused) or `Export now`. I prefer `Start export` because it implies background processing. Also add a small help link: "How exports work" (opens in new tab) that is keyboard reachable. olivia: product notes — exports can be large and take minutes. must surface estimated size + a checkbox: "Notify me when export completes" (checked by default). Also add a note about retention/expiry for the generated file and default file format selector. We also need to track analytics event: `export_initiated` with `format`, `count`, `user_opt_in_notify`. deploy-bot: staging: modal/export-v2 pushed to staging at commit 9f3a2b — please smoke test. :rocket: mia: ok action items recap: - focus handling: set focus to heading on open (dev) - collapse preview for SR and add explicit expand control (dev/design) - CTA copy: change to `Start export` and add `aria-label` with count (design/product) - add "Notify me when export completes" checkbox and small retention copy (product) - analytics event `export_initiated` + payload (eng) - add keyboard-accessible "How exports work" link (design) Can folks +1 and I'll file a tiny spec in Figma + tickets? :thumbsup: josh: +1, I'll take the focus + collapse work and leave the copy to leo/anita. anita: +1, will write the a11y checklist for the ticket. leo: +1, dropping updated mock in the thread by EOD.
